concept.prompt:
SUBJECT: single game prop concept for image-to-3D, an original cultivation one-handed straight double-edged Chinese sword (jian), about 95 cm long overall (blade about 70 cm, hilt and pommel about 25 cm), the BARE sword without scabbard, lying perfectly HORIZONTAL and perfectly straight in the frame, blade pointing to the RIGHT, seen in strict orthographic SIDE PROFILE, the blade and guard fully visible, solid thick readable blade with a clearly visible central ridge, ancient legendary blade of dark aged steel, slightly longer, strong central ridge and a few subtle ancient notches, bronze guard cast as a stern mountain-guardian beast face with weathered green verdigris in recesses, grip wrapped in aged cinnabar red cord, heavy ancient bronze pommel ring, solemn imposing sword from a sword tomb, the most prestigious of all, restrained not flashy, compact construction as one single object, no loose small parts, no dangling thin chains.
STYLE: semi-realistic stylized 3D game asset concept for a Chinese fantasy cultivation world, cinematic painterly quality, believable materials with hand-painted detail: polished steel, bronze, jade, lacquered wood grain, silk cord, clear readable silhouette, large shapes first and fine detail second, color guide (use only what the subject needs): aged dark bronze (#AE8B49), weathered dark steel (#464540, #7D786C), old gold, cinnabar red (#9D392E), dark wood (#4D3324).
RENDER: neutral flat even studio lighting, soft diffuse light from the front, no strong directional shadows, no dramatic lighting, no colored rim light, no color cast, neutral white balance, plain light grey seamless background (#D8D8D8), no floor shadow, orthographic camera, strict SIDE VIEW, whole subject centered and fully inside the frame with generous margin on all sides.
AVOID: no text, no letters, no calligraphy, no engraved characters, no seal script, no watermark, no logo, no signature, no glow, no bloom, no light rays, no particles, no sparks, no smoke, no fog, no snow, no magic effects, no motion lines, no aura, no energy trail, no cel shading, no toon outlines, no black contour lines, no flat cartoon colors, no anime style, no photograph, no plastic look, no mirror-like reflections, no baked dramatic shadows, no night scene, no purple tint on the background, no ground, no stand, no table, no scabbard, no hand holding it, no crossguard, no European sword shapes, no background scenery, no second object, no cropped parts.
